limitations: Only reviewed DIRECT effects/exact Production targets are projected; mixed technologies expose their numeric subset and omitted effects explicitly.
No caste/class/category selectors, engine-wide all-land recruitment, conditional battle effects, overlapping same-bonus sets or raw missile-strength/reload interpretations are admitted.
Percent/flat mapping uses exact CA descriptions and specific bonus rows; no generic effect-name parser.
The existing internal stacking contract is used; no claim of universal in-game stacking semantics.
